    Right almost split maps into indecomposable projectives; all indecomposables #

    A summand of a finite free module lifts along surjections (IsFreeSummand.lift). If its endomorphism ring is local, it has a unique maximal submodule, and the inclusion of that submodule is right almost split (exists_rightAlmostSplit_of_freeSummand). Together with exists_rightAlmostSplit, every finite-dimensional module with local endomorphism ring has a right almost split map (exists_rightAlmostSplit').
